title: RUN
blurb: One syllable, total urgency, and absolutely no supporting information. That is the whole design: you are not told what is coming, only that remaining here has stopped being viable, and your imagination fills in something worse than any explanation could. It functions as the internet's evacuation order and works on anything approaching, escalating, or deteriorating at speed. Drop it over a video the instant the situation turns, or use it in a call when somebody starts a sentence with 'so I've been thinking about the flat'. Leave now, ask later.
